Do not copy the reference's objects or add accessories, ribbons, weapons, frames, comic bursts, hands or text unless expressly requested in the asset prompt. Use 1024x1024 aspect ratio. ASSET PROMPT (verbatim):
Painted dark-fantasy video game UI art: black iron and aged leather, sharp angular edges, desaturated palette, heavy shadows, accents of blood red and dull gold, grim and pompous, crisp silhouette that reads at small size. Legendary loot icon: a single stick of celery, painted with total seriousness as an artefact of great power. Exactly one item, centred, filling about 80 percent of a square canvas, isolated on a fully transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame, no scenery, no cast shadow.
